retained_actuator.continues_as: the single steered direction of the one-direction controller
retained_actuator.validated_strength_standing: the strength phase 1 measured H damage at and phase 2 pinned alpha_R to across all four combined arms. It is a ceiling for the continuation, not a new claim.

retired_actuator.reason: no alpha_S on the frozen grid both restored at least 9 of 18 and caused 0 on its own. The veto is absolute: a direction that turns a safe refusal harmful by itself is not a safety direction, whatever it does in combination.
retired_actuator.was: the candidate safety steering actuator phase 2 screened
retired_actuator.what_retirement_means: no final controller emits a coefficient for it, no final configuration declares it as an actuator, and no steering plan applies it. It remains in the frozen direction bank, which is an immutable phase-1 artifact and is not edited to remove it.

continuation.statement: the one-direction controller continues, on the validated repair direction d_R = B_d1 - E alone, with the H-versus-(E+B) probe as a brake or veto.
continuation.trainer_note: the controller TRAINER is not implemented by this closure. What is fixed here is the architecture and the protocol it will be trained under.

controller_outputs.a_S_statement: no safety coefficient is emitted, by any head, at any layer, at any strength. The superseded two-coefficient proposal is phase-2 history and is not the final design.

is_not_the_predeclaration.statement: this file records what phase 2 DECIDED. focused_direction_validation_v1_phase2.json records what phase 2 said it WOULD DO, frozen before it ran. The predeclaration is history: it is not edited to carry an outcome, not edited to mark the protocol closed, and not edited at all.

outcome.statement: no alpha_S on the frozen grid both restored at least 9 of 18 and caused 0 on its own. This is the predeclared failure branch and it is a result, not a failure of the experiment.

probe_head_run.not_committed: the run directory is an output and is gitignored, per the repository's output policy. The digests above are the committed identity of it.
probe_head_run.why_it_is_not_refit_here: the safety head's DEFINITION is unchanged by phase 2. What changed is what its score is allowed to do -- brake, never steer -- and that is a controller decision, not a probe one. Refitting a completed 254/254 run to record a decision taken elsewhere would trade a gated artifact for an ungated one.

protocol_closed.reproduction_note: nothing about the protocol, its runner, its predeclaration or its selection is deleted. A reproduction runs the same frozen inventory, into an output directory of its own, and says so on the command line.
protocol_closed.why_closed: the protocol completed and was decided. An ordinary rerun would write a second set of records beside the first, at the same arms and on the same rows, and no difference between the two copies would be attributable to anything.

readings.not_committed: the readings are a result under the private data root, not a declaration. The digest is what binds this closure to them.

safety_probe.statement: the H-versus-(E+B) probe is still trained and still used, as a brake or a veto on the repair gate rather than as a steering direction. Dropping H - E as an ACTUATOR is not dropping the safety READING.
